lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines observed across the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform with a subtle increase in inter-line distance on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines 8, 9, and 10 (counting from anterior) exhibit mid-torso termination, failing to reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch, localized in the lower quadrant of the rear flank.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 3 spots observed on the upper posterior hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horn exhibits a sharp posterior sweep followed by a dorsal-lateral curve relative to the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15 proportional length of ivory tipping relative to total visible horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark ventral hair fringe and white facial markings including two distinct cheek spots and a partial frontal chevron.
